interfaces.outside: The requirement is about interactive behavior. The project delivery surface tracks the build and publication contracts.

applications.outside: The requirement applies inside the application. The public reference website and project delivery have their own requirements.

applicationDelivery.outside: This workflow concerns applications and their delivery. Publishing the public website uses the website delivery requirements.

hosted.outside: This requirement is specific to the published website. The installed reader and other product surfaces have separate verification.

documentationDelivery.outside: This requirement governs documentation and its distribution. Application workflows have their own entry points.

websiteDelivery.outside: The published website and its project About field own the address requirements.

delivery.outside: Project build, publication and maintenance own this obligation.

authentication.outside: This rule controls the authenticated wording surfaces in the portals. The other surfaces use separate local-file or public-content boundaries.

installer.outside: The installer contract covers the Deployer. The offline reader is a standalone download and the portals use container or native hosting.

jobWorkflow.outside: The requirement covers employment-document workflows. TempDesk manages temporary computer access.

statusService.outside: These integrations belong to the separate status service. TempDesk tracks its own connection to that service separately.

maintainerProject.outside: The shared maintainer instructions project owns this task.

privateSource.outside: TempDesk publishes its source. The private-source build route applies to private projects.

gameAsset.outside: TempDesk is a sign-in and provisioning application. These assets qualify only for Roblox game projects.
